description: Alpha: a unified local-first workspace for documents, spreadsheets, presentations and PDFs with a private AI assistant (Ollama or your own keys, MCP). Browser and iPadOS. MIT OR Apache-2.0.
short_description: A local-first workspace for documents, spreadsheets, slides and PDFs with a private AI assistant.
long_description: WorkCraft is a unified, local-first workspace in the browser: WordCraft, GridCraft, DeckCraft and PdfCraft side by side next to a code editor, a terminal and an AI assistant that works across every file through MCP. Run models locally with Ollama or bring your own API keys. Team Mode, 44 apps in ready-made workspaces, usable in the browser at workcraft.cc/app, iPadOS and Apple Pencil support. No account, no telemetry. Alpha, MIT OR Apache-2.0.
